mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in the past month indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in past month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >0.5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), increased cost of capital reduces corporate investment and earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 98.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 98.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS increase > 0.5% in past month) boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL inflation rise > 0.2% and HOUST decline > 0.5% in the past month signal stagflationary pressures, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rise > 0.2% and HOUST decline > 0.5% in past month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.2% and HOUST declines >0.5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized rate > 3.0%) in the most recent quarter signals robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 3.0%.
